official_document_review.actual_read: Publisher abstract only, directly opened/read. Prose free recall had distinct immediate/delayed results under studied conditions. No full article/PDF, guitar effect, effect-size or universal schedule claim.

Actual complete primary web body read: random assignment of factor levels to experimental units and design planning. Authored potential outcomes/allocation enumeration are separate; no ANOVA or sample-size adequacy claim.

unread_reference.scope: Earlier timed-out full-PDF attempt recorded by author; not retried or claimed read by reviewer.

boundaries: Target-specific answer cues and exact versus restricted-triad acceptance are authored item rules, not a new API, full harmonic taxonomy or physical performance proof.
Retrieval confidence clamp, RAG metrics, practice tracking names and read test assertions are not actual learner answers, retention probabilities, runtime tests or repository-wide absence evidence.

One fictional learner trace distinguishes offers, observed first responses, eligibility, retries, final answers and assisted successes. Missingness is not silently wrong; deterministic completion bounds are not confidence intervals.

Counterfactual illustration uses a separate eight-unit population. Later no-treatment outcomes differ from earlier pretests unless an assumption equates them; identical observations fit benefit/no-effect/harm.
All256Y0vectors are possible worlds without assigned probabilities; tight bounds-1/4to3/4 are finite identification limits, not population estimates orCI.

Seventy hypothetical uniform balanced allocations per fixed world yield an unbiased assignment average under stated assumptions, not a guaranteed one-assignment sign, actual randomization, p-value or observed effect.

Repeated item rows from one learner are not independent randomized participants. No query, formatter/test/quiz run, recruitment, memory write, causal experiment, paid call, host/player or production correction performed by reviewer.
